description: Kyte-Doolittle hydropathy profiles of MIC26 and MIC27 with UniProt TM annotations and the alignment-mapped MIC27 TM2 region
code:
import numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt, json, os

S26="MFKVIQRSVGPASLSLLTFKVYAAPKKDSPPKNSVKVDELSLYSVPEGQSKYVEEARSQLEESISQLRHYCEPYTTWCQETYSQTKPKMQSLVQWGLDSYDYLQNAPPGFFPRLGVIGFAGLIGLLLARGSKIKKLVYPPGFMGLAASLYYPQQAIVFAQVSGERLYDWGLRGYIVIEDLWKENFQKPGNVKNSPGTK"
S27="MAAIRMGKLTTMPAGLIYASVSVHAAKQEESKKQLVKPEQLPIYTAPPLQSKYVEEQPGHLQMGFASIRTATGCYIGWCKGVYVFVKNGIMDTVQFGKDAYVYLKNPPRDFLPKMGVITVSGLAGLVSARKGSKFKKITYPLGLATLGATVCYPVQSVIIAKVTAKKVYATSQQIFGAVKSLWTKSSKEESLPKPKEKTKLGSSSEIEVPAKTTHVLKHSVPLPTELSSEAKTKSESTSGATQFMPDPKLMDHGQSHPEDIDMYSTRS"

# Kyte-Doolittle hydropathy (J Mol Biol 1982)
KD=dict(A=1.8,R=-4.5,N=-3.5,D=-3.5,C=2.5,Q=-3.5,E=-3.5,G=-0.4,H=-3.2,I=4.5,
        L=3.8,K=-3.9,M=1.9,F=2.8,P=-1.6,S=-0.8,T=-0.7,W=-0.9,Y=-1.3,V=4.2)
# Eisenberg normalized consensus hydrophobicity (Faraday Symp Chem Soc 1982 / JMB 1984)
EIS=dict(A=0.62,R=-2.53,N=-0.78,D=-0.90,C=0.29,Q=-0.85,E=-0.74,G=0.48,H=-0.40,I=1.38,
         L=1.06,K=-1.50,M=0.64,F=1.19,P=0.12,S=-0.18,T=-0.05,W=0.81,Y=0.26,V=1.08)

def sliding(seq, scale, w):
    h=np.array([scale[c] for c in seq]); n=len(seq); out=np.full(n,np.nan)
    for i in range(n-w+1): out[i+w//2]=h[i:i+w].mean()
    return out

def moment(seq, scale, w=18, delta=100.0):
    """Eisenberg hydrophobic moment per residue window (mu_H), helical periodicity delta deg."""
    h=np.array([scale[c] for c in seq]); n=len(seq); out=np.full(n,np.nan)
    d=np.deg2rad(delta)
    for i in range(n-w+1):
        idx=np.arange(w); seg=h[i:i+w]
        mu=np.sqrt((seg*np.cos(idx*d)).sum()**2+(seg*np.sin(idx*d)).sum()**2)/w
        out[i+w//2]=mu
    return out

res={}
for name,S in [("MIC26",S26),("MIC27",S27)]:
    res[name]=dict(seq=S, kd19=sliding(S,KD,19), eis18=sliding(S,EIS,18), mu18=moment(S,EIS,18))

TM={"MIC26":[(108,128)], "MIC27":[(111,129),(138,155)]}
TMcons={"MIC26":[(110,128),(136,153)]}  # MIC27 TMs mapped onto MIC26 by alignment

fig,axes=plt.subplots(2,1,figsize=(13,7),sharex=False)
for ax,name in zip(axes,["MIC26","MIC27"]):
    S=res[name]["seq"]; x=np.arange(1,len(S)+1)
    ax.plot(x,res[name]["kd19"],color="#2b6cb0",lw=1.8,label="Kyte-Doolittle, window 19")
    ax.axhline(1.6,color="#c53030",ls="--",lw=1,label="TM threshold 1.6")
    ax.axhline(0,color="grey",lw=0.6)
    for (s,e) in TM[name]:
        ax.axvspan(s,e,color="#f6ad55",alpha=0.45)
        ax.text((s+e)/2,3.3,f"UniProt TM\n{s}-{e}",ha="center",fontsize=8)
    if name=="MIC26":
        s,e=TMcons["MIC26"][1]
        ax.axvspan(s,e,color="#68d391",alpha=0.45)
        ax.text((s+e)/2,3.3,f"MIC27 TM2\nmapped {s}-{e}",ha="center",fontsize=8)
        ax.axvline(117,color="black",ls=":",lw=1.4)
        ax.text(117,-3.4,"I117T",fontsize=8,ha="center")
    ax.set_ylim(-4,4.2); ax.set_xlim(1,len(S))
    ax.set_title(f"{name} hydropathy profile")
    ax.set_ylabel("mean hydropathy")
    ax.set_xlabel("residue")
    ax.legend(fontsize=8,loc="lower left")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()

# peak table
rows=[]
for name in ["MIC26","MIC27"]:
    kd=res[name]["kd19"]; S=res[name]["seq"]
    above=np.where(kd>1.6)[0]
    # group contiguous
    groups=[]
    for i in above:
        if groups and i==groups[-1][-1]+1: groups[-1].append(i)
        else: groups.append([i])
    for grp in groups:
        c=grp[int(np.argmax(kd[grp]))]
        rows.append(dict(protein=name, centre_res=c+1, window=f"{c+1-9}-{c+1+9}",
                         peak_KD=round(float(kd[c]),2), n_res_above_1p6=len(grp),
                         seq=S[max(0,c-9):c+10]))
peaks=pd.DataFrame(rows)
print(peaks.to_string(index=False))
peaks.to_csv("hydropathy_peaks.csv",index=False)
